features.title: Discover official campaigns and map metadata
features.requirement: Catalog id1, Scourge of Armagon, Dissolution of Eternity, Dimension of the Past, Dimension of the Machine, Dawn of the Machine and CTF with their installed edition, episodes, maps, and authored mode flags.

evidence.observation: Builds installed episodes from mapdb and separates add-on directories.
Dopa shares the mg1 gamecode; the rerelease source has six gamecode trees.

workflows.trigger: Open content selection after mounting classic and rerelease installations.
steps: Compare the catalog with installed campaign metadata.
Select each official campaign and inspect its episode and map entries.
workflows.observableOutcome: Each installed campaign has an edition-qualified launch choice and the correct map list; missing content has an actionable state.

features.title: Select gameplay separately from content and engine behavior
features.requirement: Preserve native campaign launch and make gameplay implementation, content origin, behavior profile, mode and protocol explicit independent session choices.

evidence.observation: Both behavior choices keep episode.dir as gamecode/content directory.
Returns id1 and loses the expansion mount; this is an incomplete alternative launch.
Queues game before user-selected ruleset, skill and map.

workflows.trigger: Launch classic id1 gameplay on mg1 content and rerelease Hipnotic gameplay with classic engine behavior.
steps: Choose content and gameplay independently.
Launch, inspect resolved module and map provenance, then reopen settings.
workflows.observableOutcome: The requested map remains mounted, the requested gameplay owns callbacks, and launch-time config cannot overwrite selected behavior.

gaps: ClassicProgsPlan is not a complete UI/runtime integration and does not prove arbitrary content/gameplay combinations.

features.title: Resolve classic, rerelease and mod assets by provenance
features.requirement: Mount multiple installations with explicit edition and mod precedence, contained writable data, and independent gamecode/map selection.

evidence.observation: Detects rerelease roots, installs search paths and applies command-line content switches.
Rebuilds active game-directory search paths.

workflows.trigger: Mount a classic root with a nested rerelease and an add-on with colliding filenames.
steps: Resolve id1/progs.dat and an expansion map for each selected edition.
Switch game directory and repeat the lookup.
workflows.observableOutcome: Asset and gamecode provenance match the selection on every lookup and stale mounts cannot silently change gameplay.

gaps: Existing rerelease-first precedence cannot alone represent arbitrary independent choices.

features.title: Apply edition-specific difficulty and player spawn rules
features.requirement: Expose all authored difficulty levels and preserve selected gamecode health, capacity, damage and monster rules independently of an engine profile label.

evidence.observation: Classic spawn establishes player health and inventory.
Rerelease Hipnotic starts Nightmare non-deathmatch players at 50 health and max_health.

workflows.trigger: Start each native campaign on Normal and Nightmare, then force the alternate engine profile.
steps: Read initial health and capacity.
Take damage, pick up health and respawn under each selected gameplay module.
workflows.observableOutcome: Difficulty follows selected gameplay; forcing movement behavior does not silently replace classic or rerelease balance.

features.title: Carry campaign state through changelevel and restart
features.requirement: Retain spawn parameters, serverflags, inventory, keys and authored transition/reset behavior across campaign maps.

evidence.observation: Invokes selected gamecode SetChangeParms and saves per-client spawn parameters.
Changes server level while preserving campaign parameters.
Classic gamecode controls item and health carryover.

workflows.trigger: Acquire campaign items and use a level exit.
steps: Record inventory and progression state.
Change level, die and respawn, then restart the map.
workflows.observableOutcome: Transition, respawn and restart each apply their own authored state policy without losing unrelated campaign progress.

features.title: Report secrets, kills and completion statistics
features.requirement: Count authored secrets and monsters, show time and completion statistics, and advance intermission/endings after the intended input.

evidence.observation: Secret triggers increment total secrets and use authored targets.
Draws level completion statistics.
Consumes intermission and finale server messages.

workflows.trigger: Find a secret, kill a monster and complete a level.
steps: Compare HUD totals with triggered events.
Enter intermission, inspect time/secrets/kills, then acknowledge the ending.
workflows.observableOutcome: Statistics count each event once and completion advances through the authored next-map or ending sequence.

features.title: Keep NetQuake and QuakeWorld gamecode host contracts distinct
features.requirement: Preserve VM validation, global/entity layouts, builtins and callbacks for NQ and QW; select wire codecs separately from gamecode host ABI.

evidence.observation: NQ installs its own layouts, CRC set and builtin table.
QW has distinct layouts, CRC, qwprogs.dat preference and spectator callbacks.
Validates program format and selected host system CRC.

workflows.trigger: Load native NQ and QW external QuakeC mods, then deliberately cross their host ABI.
steps: Run spawn, think, touch and player callbacks on the correct host.
Attempt an incompatible system-CRC program and inspect the diagnostic.
workflows.observableOutcome: Each supported host executes its own contracts; incompatible bytecode fails explicitly before world mutation.

gaps: Retail rerelease NQ bytecode is not QW ABI-compatible merely because the VM or wire transport is shared.

features.title: Preserve foreign entity classes, fields and target graphs
features.requirement: Resolve every required entity against the actual selected gameplay implementation and preserve raw authored fields and target graphs through explicit adapters.

evidence.observation: Parses fields and resolves selected-program spawn functions; unknown keys may be discarded.
Current fallback resolves through a lossy rename/inhibit table.

workflows.trigger: Load a foreign expansion map whose classes or fields are absent in selected gameplay.
steps: Enumerate active classnames and properties per selected module.
Trigger scripted spawns, target chains and progression gates.
workflows.observableOutcome: Required entities retain mechanics and properties; absence is reported as unfinished behavior rather than silently removing the entity.

gaps: Current rename/inhibit table and union-of-program function tests cannot prove per-program semantic coverage.

features.title: Preserve classic and rerelease movement clocks
features.requirement: Keep engine acceleration, friction, gravity, water movement and source tick profiles separate from gamecode jump and lifecycle callbacks.

evidence.observation: Applies engine friction to player movement.
Runs player callbacks around authoritative physics.
Rerelease behavior uses an accumulator and sv_tickrate; classic is frame-coupled.

workflows.trigger: Replay movement inputs under classic and rerelease behavior at varied rendering frame rates.
steps: Walk, jump, swim, climb steps and cross moving geometry.
Compare simulation time and trajectories against each source profile.
workflows.observableOutcome: Movement obeys the selected clock and gamecode callbacks while render rate does not corrupt fixed-tick behavior.

gaps: Exact closed-source KEX physics still requires original executable evidence; absent sv_gameplayfix implementations are not inherited defaults.

evidence.observation: Legacy signon has mode/protocol/precaches but no full typed session identity.
Donor active-weapon interpretation depends on client filesystem state.

workflows.trigger: Join a native server using foreign content and expansion gameplay.
steps: Inspect negotiated session descriptors on both peers.
Try a peer missing an essential capability or content revision.
workflows.observableOutcome: Peers agree on complete gameplay/state identity or explain a concrete incompatibility before spawning.

gaps: A local mount flag or protocol number cannot identify arbitrary mixed gameplay/content sessions.

features.title: Direct connect, LAN search and server browser
features.requirement: Preserve direct connect, LAN discovery, server lists, status/ping, master registration and usable discovery when legacy services are unavailable.

evidence.observation: Starts NetQuake server discovery.
Connects to a selected server-list entry.
Sends QW master heartbeats.

workflows.trigger: Discover a LAN server, select it in the browser and connect directly by address.
steps: Inspect names, counts, protocol and ping.
Test master registration against an available service or the delivered equivalent.
workflows.observableOutcome: The player can find and join a compatible server through an executed discovery path.

gaps: Configured master endpoints do not prove live service availability or complete global browsing.

features.title: QuakeWorld content download queues and policy
features.requirement: Preserve QW map/model/sound/skin transfer, queue progression and denial policy with contained writes and correct per-category checks.

evidence.observation: Checks download categories/path restrictions and starts transfer; maps policy comparison is narrower than a maps/ prefix.
Sends subsequent download chunks.
Writes received chunks and advances the client queue.

workflows.trigger: Join a server missing permitted maps/models/sounds/skins locally.
steps: Complete allowed downloads and reconnect.
Disable each category and request an actual file in that directory.
workflows.observableOutcome: Allowed files arrive intact at contained paths; every disabled category denies all its files and failures leave a usable client.

gaps: SV_BeginDownload_f compares name === maps/ for map policy; this inspected defect must not become expected download behavior.

features.title: Passwords, spectators, rcon, filtering and flood control
features.requirement: Preserve player/spectator admission limits, password checks, rcon, IP filters, chat flood protection, status and operator logs.

evidence.observation: Checks passwords and available player/spectator slots.
Validates rcon and dispatches server-profile commands.
Applies IP filter policy.
Configures flood protection.

workflows.trigger: Join with valid/invalid credentials and operate a populated QW server.
steps: Exercise spectator limits, filters, flood policy and valid/invalid rcon.
Inspect status/log output and remaining clients.
workflows.observableOutcome: Admission and operator policy are enforced with accurate feedback and no credential exposure in retained logs.

gaps: Donor rcon logging includes raw command text, including its password argument; preserve administration while fixing credential disclosure.

features.title: Separate documented Q1 wire compatibility from retail KEX claims
features.requirement: Account explicitly for retail rerelease network/service functionality and provide required native equivalents where proprietary interoperability cannot be established.

evidence.observation: Donor explicitly excludes retail KEX server interoperability.
Several rerelease packet payloads are local documented designs rather than known retail wire contracts.

workflows.trigger: Compare supported original-server connections with the native replacement multiplayer workflow.
steps: Execute every claimed wire compatibility direction.
Record unsupported retail endpoints and demonstrate the required in-engine equivalent.
workflows.observableOutcome: Compatibility claims match executed protocol evidence and required gameplay/service workflows remain available.

gaps: No retail KEX wire interoperability evidence was obtained; local packet support must not be labeled retail compatibility.

features.title: Localized prompts and choice impulses
features.requirement: Preserve targeted prompt/choice/clear events, localized text, selection impulses and per-player input ownership.

evidence.observation: Serializes targeted localized prompt text.
Serializes choice text and impulse.
Draws numbered prompt choices in the active pane.

workflows.trigger: Open a gamecode prompt with several choices for one player.
steps: Choose using keyboard and controller.
Clear/reopen it and repeat with another local player.
workflows.observableOutcome: The intended player sees readable choices and exactly its selected impulse reaches gameplay.

features.title: Rerelease finale completion acknowledgement
features.requirement: Preserve finale display, user acknowledgement and the gamecode query that advances the ending sequence.

evidence.observation: Exposes actual finale acknowledgement to gamecode.
Reports the engine's finale acknowledgement flag.

workflows.trigger: Reach a rerelease finale and wait without input before acknowledging it.
steps: Observe gamecode query results before/after acknowledgement.
Start another level/finale to inspect reset.
workflows.observableOutcome: The ending advances after its intended acknowledgement and does not reuse stale completion state.

features.title: Achievement persistence and player UI
features.requirement: Turn authored achievement events into deduplicated durable awards with readable UI and explicit local/provider identity.

evidence.observation: Achievement payload is read and logged only.
Authored hidden-difficulty discovery emits an achievement.

workflows.trigger: Earn an authored achievement, repeat its trigger and restart the game.
steps: Inspect award UI and durable per-player state.
Earn it with another local player.
workflows.observableOutcome: Each eligible player receives one retained award and can inspect it after restart.

gaps: Packet logging does not implement achievement storage/UI and does not establish Steam/provider integration.

features.title: Level-completed events and return-to-lobby lifecycle
features.requirement: Consume level-completed/back-to-lobby events through durable progression, session teardown and a usable lobby with host/join/leave/start transitions.

evidence.observation: Sets a completion flag without a discovered downstream workflow.
Sets a lobby flag and logs it.

workflows.trigger: Finish a match/campaign segment and return all participants to the lobby.
steps: Inspect progression and roster retention.
Change the next match, ready participants and start again.
workflows.observableOutcome: Completion updates progress once and participants can start another session from a functioning lobby.

gaps: Parsed booleans alone do not implement lobby lifecycle or progression consumption.

features.title: Local and online add-on browsing
features.requirement: Preserve local add-on discovery and implement required catalog, install/update/remove and launch workflows with source identity and progress/error feedback.

evidence.observation: Lists content directories under the mounted root.
Retains mounted add-on directories for menus.

workflows.trigger: Browse installed add-ons and an available online/equivalent catalog.
steps: Install or update an add-on, inspect progress and launch it.
Remove it and refresh the catalog.
workflows.observableOutcome: Content actions leave a consistent catalog and launch the selected revision with explicit provenance.

gaps: No complete online Q1 catalog/download service was found; local discovery alone is incomplete.

features.title: Identify and launch the required Quake 64 content
features.requirement: Retain the required Quake 64 product until its content identity, dependency manifest, format differences and launch behavior are resolved.

evidence.observation: Catalog is driven by mounted metadata; this does not itself establish Quake 64 identity or coverage.

workflows.trigger: Open the catalog with the required Quake 64 installation available.
steps: Resolve its canonical files and dependencies through W07.
Launch its authored entry and inspect edition-specific assets/progression.
workflows.observableOutcome: Quake 64 has a verified product identity and usable native launch, or remains visibly blocked by the exact missing input.

gaps: Product inventory marks Quake 64 identity unresolved; no Quake 64 content or gameplay behavior is certified here.

features.title: PAK, ZIP/KPF and WAD content loading
features.requirement: Preserve archive directory parsing, compressed ZIP/KPF assets, WAD lumps and palette/image resource lookup with provenance-aware priority.

evidence.observation: Validates and indexes PAK entries.
Loads ZIP/KPF entries for the virtual filesystem.
Validates WAD2 header and lump directory.

workflows.trigger: Mount official PAK/KPF content and a mod that overrides an image/WAD lump.
steps: Read compressed and uncompressed assets.
Inspect palette/image output and priority after a game switch.
workflows.observableOutcome: Files decode through the correct archive and the selected provenance supplies visible image resources.

features.title: Rerelease gib and corpse collision semantics
features.requirement: Preserve declared rerelease gib movement and corpse collision distinctions under an explicit behavior profile, with original-runtime evidence for closed-source details.

evidence.observation: Gib bounce policy is profile-gated in the donor.
Corpse collision is handled separately from ordinary solid actors.

workflows.trigger: Create gibs and corpses under both engine behavior profiles.
steps: Trace point projectiles and move player-sized hulls through corpses.
Measure bounce, gravity and resting behavior.
workflows.observableOutcome: The selected profile's declared traces and gib trajectories match authoritative evidence.

gaps: Current gib policy follows available QC comments where open engines differ; exact KEX behavior is not proven.

features.title: Runtime chase camera and diagnostic commands
features.requirement: Preserve player-visible chase camera tracing and runtime diagnostics/operator controls needed to inspect maps, actors, rendering and sound.

evidence.observation: Places the chase camera using world traces.
Reports live sound configuration.
Reports runtime server/player state.

workflows.trigger: Enable chase view and run the relevant diagnostics during a live map.
steps: Move near walls and inspect camera clipping.
Inspect status/audio values and return to ordinary view.
workflows.observableOutcome: The camera respects world obstruction and diagnostics report the running session without breaking gameplay.

gaps: Separate authoring/compiler/editor applications remain source-role inventory work; this record claims only named runtime behavior.
